name: template-picker-dialog
title: Template picker dialog
description: Start from a template: a dialog with search, categories, a grid of cards, a preview of the one in focus and Blank always first.
docs: Pass templates ({ id, name, description, category, preview, tags }) and categories ({ id, label }). The preview is any node that fills its box, such as an SVG with a viewBox, because it is drawn small on the card and larger beside the grid. onSelect receives the template id, or null for Blank, which is always the first card and the default. Return a promise and the dialog locks while it runs, cannot be closed and closes when it resolves; if it rejects, it stays open and says why. The arrow keys move across the grid and choose, Enter makes it, and Escape empties a search before it closes the dialog. Below 640px the side panel becomes a sheet at the foot. What is chosen is always in the grid: a pick that a search or a category hides is set aside and Blank stands in until the filter lets go of it, and a search that finds nothing in the open category says where the matches are and offers Search all templates. TemplatePickerPanel is the inside of the dialog, for a page of its own. labels translates every word.
